name: Palm Coast Town Center / Central Park
strengths: Large municipal family-event cluster; one city vendor relationship can unlock multiple dates.
risks: Dessert overlap varies by event. Short evening windows can hurt frozen-dessert volume. City packet does not guarantee a slot.
power: Event-specific. Confirm plug type, amperage and whether truck placement can reach power.
access: Confirm serving orientation, load-in route and whether the truck remains locked in until event close.
nextQuestion: Which events have an actual dessert opening and how many direct competitors are already accepted?

name: Flagler County Fairgrounds
strengths: Multiple large event organizers rent the same property, creating a reusable venue profile.
risks: Fair board, county venue staff and private renters are different decision-makers. A fairgrounds event listing is not permission to vend.
power: Ask each event organizer. Do not assume fairgrounds service is included.
access: Confirm overnight rules, gate/load-in, surface, truck placement and whether an event locks vendors in.
nextQuestion: Who controls concessions for this specific renter and what does the vendor owe beyond the organizer fee?

name: Francis Field
recurringEvents: Original Florida Key Lime Pie Festival
strengths: High-value event factory with recurring family, tourist and food-focused crowds.
risks: Crowd quality varies wildly by event. Dessert-heavy festivals can create severe overlap even when attendance is large.
power: Event-specific. Confirm generator policy, electrical availability and fire requirements.
access: Downtown event logistics may mean fixed load-in/out windows and tight truck placement.
nextQuestion: For this edition, what are the truck fee, direct dessert competitors, load-in window and actual prior attendance?

name: Princess Place Preserve
strengths: Long-dwell outdoor festival setting can support dessert demand when weather cooperates.
risks: Weather disruption is real. Remote placement, long hours and multi-day requirements can crush economics.
power: Likely generator dependent unless organizer supplies temporary service. Verify.
access: Ask about overnight storage, ground conditions, load-in and whether leaving early is prohibited.
nextQuestion: What did the most recent comparable edition actually draw, and how many dessert vendors were there?

name: Florida Agricultural Museum
recurringEvents: Food Truck Friday on the Farm
strengths: Purpose-built recurring food-truck format with family activities and repeat dates.
risks: Free admission does not mean free vending. Repeat success depends on placement, dessert saturation and weather.
access: Ask for exact truck position and rain-credit policy.
nextQuestion: What is the current fee and which frozen-dessert categories are already booked?

name: Grand Haven
strengths: Private promoted crowd can reduce speculative risk, especially with prepaid packages.
risks: Cafe/club food service rights, gate access and catering approval.
power: Potential shore power, but confirm exact plug and amperage.
access: Coordinate gate entry and an approved common-area position.
nextQuestion: Can the host guarantee attendance or prepay a defined number of treats?
